name: NamingSignal API
description: Evidence-first naming brief, generation, domain/namespace checking, ranking, and finalist research. Registry not-found is a likely-unregistered signal, not a purchase guarantee; trademark output is preliminary research only. Errors always use the {error, code, retryable} envelope; rate-limited responses add Retry-After, retryAfterSeconds, and resetAt.
